items.name: Baked white fish fillet with herb crust
items.preparation: baked or roasted with herbs and a little oil

items.name: Red/wild rice and grain blend
items.preparation: boiled, tossed as a grain salad

items.name: Olive oil / vinaigrette dressing
items.preparation: tossed with greens and grains, plus oil used on fish

scale_cues: Square white dinner plate assumed about 26 cm across; cauliflower floret size (about 5-6 cm each) and fork tines at the top left edge used as secondary size references.
assumptions: The pale herb-crusted block is taken to be a white fish fillet; it could instead be chicken breast or tofu, which would change calories and protein.
The reddish-brown grains are taken to be a red or wild rice blend.
Small yellow pieces are assumed to be corn kernels, though some may be pine nuts or other nuts, which would raise calories.
A light oil-based dressing is assumed on the greens and grains because of their sheen; the amount is not directly visible.
Cauliflower is assumed plain steamed with no butter or oil added.
Portion depth is estimated from a single overhead view, so piled items such as the greens and grains are uncertain.
